demo.title: toll.sh
demo.code:
# Check a Robinhood Chain coin before buying
curl -s "https://t0ll.xyz/api/check?addr=<token>&chain=rh&wait=1"

# Pre-sign check: ALLOW / WARN / BLOCK before signing
curl -s -X POST https://t0ll.xyz/api/tx/check \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"chainId":4663,"from":"<wallet>","to":"<to>","data":"<calldata>","value":"0"}'

setup: No key needed for the free calls (10 new coins a day per caller)
No daily limit over x402: 0.005 USDG per check on Robinhood Chain
MCP (remote, no auth): https://t0ll.xyz/mcp · Docs: https://t0ll.xyz/llms.txt
